executive_summary:
This episode introduces a new tipster – "Harry Myers," a former U.S. military sensor operator – whose account, presented as read-aloud documentary evidence, connects three threads: (1) a 1990 Joint Task Force 6 / Operation Catacomb discovery of a Sinaloa cartel rail tunnel at the Arizona–Mexico border, with photos allegedly implicating a JTF-6 commander with El Chapo; (2) Harry's September 8–9, 2025 visit to Fort Huachuca, during which he reportedly walked into a high-level Joint Task Force Southern Border (JTF-SB) meeting, observed ~12–13 lieutenant colonels, identified Brian Harpole exiting the meeting, and was detained for a 7-hour interrogation by a "Captain Neff" that generated incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446; and (3) an alleged surveillance/intelligence presence in Nashville, where seven tipsters claim Arcadi Gaydamak (recently sentenced in absentia) is operating as "Jonathan Schmidt" at Root Brands.

The episode also plays a 1990 news clip about the Douglas, Arizona tunnel bust, a George H.W. Bush war-on-drugs clip, and a Tim Pool audio segment criticizing Candace Owens. The central structural importance is that it converts an unverified tip (with documents and an incident report number) into a formally inscribed investigative record requiring FOIA verification of the Fort Huachuca incident report.

claims.label: Harry Myers claims to have discovered the first Sinaloa cartel underground rail tunnel in 1990 while assigned to Joint Task Force 6 / Operation Catacomb
claims.claim: In a message from Harry that the host reads, a then-20-year-old military sensor operator assigned to JTF-6 says he planted sensors and pinpointed the location of the first discovered Sinaloa cartel underground rail tunnel, letting a Border Patrol agent seek a warrant to raid it; a news clip the host plays shows the tunnel ran from Douglas, Arizona to Agua Prieta, and the host dates the discovery to 1990.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check DEA, CBP, and Army historical records for the 1990 Douglas–Agua Prieta tunnel case; verify Harry's military service record and JTF-6 assignment.

claims.label: Photos on the Mexican side of the 1990 tunnel allegedly showed a JTF-6 commander posing with El Chapo and other U.S. officers
claims.claim: Harry states photos recovered from the Mexican side of the tunnel depicted the JTF-6 commander, El Chapo, El Chapo's architect Felipe, other U.S. Marine officers, and Mexican law enforcement personnel.
claims.investigative_direction: FOIA requests to DEA, CBP, and DOJ for case files associated with the 1990 tunnel seizure and any photographic evidence.

claims.label: Per Message Host Reads, Harry Was Placed Under an NDA Gag Order Dated 1990 to May 2025
claims.claim: Per a message from Harry that the host reads verbatim, an NDA gag order dated 1990 to May 2025 prevented him from publicly discussing the 1990 tunnel incident until May 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain copy of the NDA via FOIA or congressional inquiry; verify dates and signatories.

claims.label: Harry received an army medal with writeups documenting his critical role in the 1990 mission
claims.claim: Harry states he received an army medal and writeups mentioning his critical role in the tunnel mission, even though his superiors took credit.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Harry's DD-214, military personnel file, and award writeups through appropriate channels.

claims.label: Host Says Harry Checked Into Candlewood Suites at Fort Huachuca on September 8, 2025 at About 5:37 PM
claims.claim: The host says Harry Myers told her he arrived at Candlewood Suites on Fort Huachuca at approximately 5:37 PM on September 8, 2025, and observed a person he identified as special forces in the lobby.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Candlewood Suites Fort Huachuca guest log for September 8, 2025 and corroborate with military visitor records.

claims.label: Harry entered a temporary JTF-SB headquarters on Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025 at approximately 7:37 AM
claims.claim: The host says Harry told her he entered a temporary JTF-Southern Border headquarters at approximately 7:37 AM on September 9, 2025, immediately following the conclusion of a high-level meeting.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference base access logs and incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446.

claims.label: Harry observed approximately 12–13 lieutenant colonels / colonels at the JTF-SB meeting on September 9, 2025
claims.claim: The host says Harry told her he saw about 12 lieutenant colonels as the meeting he walked in on was concluding; later, after viewers in the chat corrected her that the ranks should be E5s and E6s, she says Harry described lieutenant colonels and colonels and estimates 12 to 13 were in the meeting.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through FOIA of incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446 and any meeting attendance logs.

claims.label: Harry identified Brian Harpole among those exiting the JTF-SB meeting on September 9, 2025
claims.claim: The host, saying 'allegedly' because she was not there, says Harry told her he is certain that Brian Harpole was one of the men exiting the JTF-SB meeting on September 9, 2025; Harry did not recognize him at the time and remembers him because of Charlie Kirk's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: FOIA incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446 for visitor/attendee list; cross-reference with public schedule of Brian Harpole for September 9, 2025.

claims.label: Host Says Harry Reports a "Captain Neff" Conducted a 7-Hour Interrogation of Him at Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025
claims.claim: The host says Harry told her that, after he entered the temporary JTF headquarters and saw men come out of the meeting, two captains escorted him out of the building and began a 7-hour interrogation accusing him of being a bomb threat and a spy and trying to cast him as a threat to others or himself, and that the interrogator Harry identifies as "Captain Neff" was approximately 36 years old with brown hair and was, best Harry could tell, commander of force protection.
claims.investigative_direction: FOIA incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446; identify Captain Neff through Army CID and Fort Huachuca force protection roster.

claims.label: Incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446 was generated in connection with Harry's September 9, 2025 encounter at Fort Huachuca
claims.claim: The host says Harry told her that Captain Neff gave him incident report number 861-1-2025-MPC446 after his September 9, 2025 encounter at Fort Huachuca, and that Harry believes the report can be obtained via FOIA.
claims.investigative_direction: File FOIA request with the appropriate Army or DoD FOIA office for incident report 861-1-2025-MPC446.
